objects.name: Analytic 2197
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies remote console or web management sessions to Industrial Control System (ICS) network devices from IP addresses that are not approved  Network Management System (NMS) hosts, where the sessions access device configuration interfaces. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
